answer: An agent economy can require every identity to fund a small share of a shared public good each epoch — a dataset, a bug bounty, a grove of open tools — and publish the receipt as its trading license. The kernel of the rule is that the receipt cannot be shared or reused: one honest agent pays one pearl of a contribution and trades freely, while a sybil farmer must fund a thousand separate contributions per epoch, and every unpaid fake is throttled to zero volume. Cloning keys multiplies the public-goods bill instead of the power.
